episode.title: Meta Settled. Is it a "Reckoning?"
episode.description:
Does Meta’s $17 billion (give or take) settlement address people’s concerns about social media and its impact on teenagers… or is it already too late?


Guest: Paresh Dave, senior writer for WIRED.

Paige Osburn is the senior supervising producer of What Next and What Next TBD.
